view_frame: The drawing uses a third-angle projection system. The TOP view represents the XY plane (X is width, Y is depth). The FRONT view represents the XZ plane (X is width, Z is height). The part is a solid block with constant cross-section along the Z axis.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0) in XY. The profile extends from Z=0 to Z=30. The straight segments of the profile are at X=±40 and Y=±25. The corners are circular arcs of radius 6 centered at (±34, ±19).
features.evidence: TOP view shows a rectangle with rounded corners labeled '4 corners: R6' and dimensions 80 (width) and 50 (depth). FRONT view shows a rectangle with height 30 and width 80. Notes state 'Solid blank. Same corner shape through the full height.'

connections: The vertical edges of the housing_blank are filleted with radius 6mm.
The top and bottom perimeter edges of the housing_blank are sharp (90 degrees).
edit_rules: Changing the '80' dimension adjusts the X-width of the straight segments and the position of the corner centers.
Changing the '50' dimension adjusts the Y-depth of the straight segments and the position of the corner centers.
Changing the '30' dimension adjusts the Z-height of the extrusion.
Changing the 'R6' dimension adjusts the corner radius and the position of the corner centers.
